response.sql: SELECT p.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) as amount, SUM(p.amount) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL) as fraction_of_total FROM payment p WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.staff_id

assumptions.assumption: "combined total across all staff" refers to the sum of all payment.amount where rental_id IS NOT NULL—consistent with the opening constraint "for payments that link to a rental"—rather than the total for all payments in the table

alternatives.interpretation: "combined total across all staff" refers to the sum of all payment.amount in the entire payment table, regardless of rental linkage, so the denominator is not filtered
